## Checklist

- [ ] `go build ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing
- [ ] `go test -race -count=1 ./...` passes
- [ ] New code has tests (see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for
      the style this project uses — prefer exercising real behavior,
      e.g. via `httptest`, over mocks where it fits)
- [ ] [`STATUS.md`](../STATUS.md) updated if this changes what's done or
      what the next steps are
